source_refs.note: Topic 1.5, printed pages 19-25 (PDF 22-28): the two groups of vertebrates and the seven classes, with the side note on bills and the figures.

blocks.text: Vertebrates are divided into two groups.

items: Group Pisces: It includes 3 classes i.e., Cyclostomata, Chondrichthyes, and Osteichthyes. They do not have limbs.
Group Tetrapoda: It includes 4 classes i.e., Amphibia, Reptilia, Aves, and Mammalia. They have four limbs.
